title: Page 262
transc:
City Point Nov 5
Geo D Sheldon Ft Monroe
Hannah Babcock dispatch received zebra the nuptial
must go at once & cannot wait
to have stalls put sligo wessels if 
it is unsafe to carry the spartans 
without debarkum and send the spit and
shoals leaving the spartans at appian or
sports mouth by order Jersey Yoke Bourse
SH Beckwith


Ft Monroe Nov 5 1864
SH Beckwith City Point
Julia Bourse your dispatch received stop the Spartans would
alby superb if sent without Stalls zebra only pension
pieces of nuptial remain here and the Spaffords of
plug pagoda zodiac they will all leave tonight without
fail tulip plunge weaseler with perfume publish and mansion
sulphur broke down off the capes last night and
came back pekin her spit have been transferred and
will leave on boat with Knaves spartans in plug 
hour unity I go to Banditti on Weaseler Babcock
Geo D Sheldon
